tasks.title: Implement pure session band computation service (D1)
tasks.description: Create services/session_service.py that computes ET pre/post-market intervals (DST-aware) for intraday timeframes and returns empty for 1 day, intersected with the loaded data range.
acceptance_criteria: Given bars spanning multiple ET session days on an intraday timeframe, When session_bands is computed, Then it returns only pre-market 04:00-09:30 ET and post-market 16:00-20:00 ET intervals and no RTH or overnight intervals.
Given timeframe is "1 day", When session_bands is computed, Then it returns an empty list.
Given the chart display timezone is UTC, When session bands are computed, Then boundaries are the same absolute ET instants (e.g., pre-market 04:00 ET appears at 09:00 UTC in EST).
Given bars crossing a US DST transition day, When session_bands is computed, Then boundaries remain at ET local session times 04:00, 09:30, 16:00, 20:00 ET.

Given a bar timestamp exactly at 09:30 ET or 16:00 ET and the loaded range [t_min, t_max], When bands are classified, Then 09:30 belongs to RTH and 16:00 belongs to post-market and no band extends outside [t_min, t_max].

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given bars spanning multiple ET session days on an intraday timeframe, When session_bands is computed, Then it returns only pre-market 04:00-09:30 ET and post-market 16:00-20:00 ET intervals and no RTH or overnight intervals.
tests.description: Call session_bands over 3 session days of 5-min bars and assert only pre/post kinds, correct start/end timestamps.
tests.expected_result: Result contains 6 intervals (3 pre + 3 post) with correct ET boundaries and kinds pre/post only.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given timeframe is "1 day", When session_bands is computed, Then it returns an empty list.
tests.description: Call session_bands with timeframe="1 day" for any range.
tests.expected_result: Returns [] regardless of bars.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the chart display timezone is UTC, When session bands are computed, Then boundaries are the same absolute ET instants (e.g., pre-market 04:00 ET appears at 09:00 UTC in EST).
tests.description: Compare UTC timestamps of bands computed for EST session day and verify they equal ET wall time converted to UTC.
tests.expected_result: Pre band start equals ET 04:00 converted to UTC (09:00 UTC in EST) and post band start equals 16:00 ET = 21:00 UTC.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given bars crossing a US DST transition day, When session_bands is computed, Then boundaries remain at ET local session times 04:00, 09:30, 16:00, 20:00 ET.
tests.description: Generate bars for week containing 2nd Sun Mar transition and verify boundaries shift by 1h UTC but stay fixed in ET local.
tests.expected_result: Boundaries on post-DST day are 1h earlier in UTC, still 04:00 ET local.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a bar timestamp exactly at 09:30 ET or 16:00 ET and the loaded range [t_min, t_max], When bands are classified, Then 09:30 belongs to RTH and 16:00 belongs to post-market and no band extends outside [t_min, t_max].
tests.description: Create bands where t_min=t_max at session boundaries and check classification and clipping.
tests.expected_result: Band containing 09:30 not classified as pre; 16:00 classified as post; all band intervals within [t_min, t_max].

tasks.title: Render pre/post session shading in chart (D1)
tasks.description: Add ui/overlays/session_overlay.py and plumb ChartPanel.set_extended_hours and MainWindow so session bands shade orange/blue at 10% only when Ext Hours ON and timeframe intraday, with stale-band cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Given Ext Hours is ON and timeframe is intraday, When the chart renders, Then pre-market bands are orange at 10% opacity and post-market bands are blue at 10% opacity while RTH and overnight remain unshaded.
Given Ext Hours is OFF, When the chart renders, Then no pre/post session bands are rendered.
Given timeframe is "1 day", When the chart renders, Then no intraday session bands are rendered.

Given Ext Hours is toggled, the symbol or timeframe changes, or a new candle arrives, When the chart updates, Then stale bands are cleared and correct bands are redrawn, and intra-bar ticks do not recompute bands.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Ext Hours is ON and timeframe is intraday, When the chart renders, Then pre-market bands are orange at 10% opacity and post-market bands are blue at 10% opacity while RTH and overnight remain unshaded.
tests.description: Offscreen ChartPanel with intraday bars and Ext ON: call update_chart and assert session overlay contains pre/post LinearRegionItems with correct brushes at 0.10 alpha.
tests.expected_result: Overlay item_count equals 2*session_days with orange brush alpha 0.10 for pre and blue 0.10 for post; no RTH items.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Ext Hours is OFF, When the chart renders, Then no pre/post session bands are rendered.
tests.description: Set Ext OFF then update_chart with same bars and assert overlay cleared.
tests.expected_result: Overlay item_count == 0.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given timeframe is "1 day", When the chart renders, Then no intraday session bands are rendered.
tests.description: Set timeframe="1 day" and render; assert no bands.
tests.expected_result: Overlay item_count == 0 for 1 day.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Ext Hours is toggled, the symbol or timeframe changes, or a new candle arrives, When the chart updates, Then stale bands are cleared and correct bands are redrawn, and intra-bar ticks do not recompute bands.
tests.description: Spy session_service.session_bands; verify call count increments on toggle/timeframe/new-candle but not on intra-bar update_last_bar with same ts.
tests.expected_result: session_bands called on full reload/new candle/toggle, not on same-ts intra-bar tick; stale items removed.

tasks.title: Implement zoom in/out around centre and reset to default framing (D3)
tasks.description: Wire ChartControls zoom_in/zoom_out/reset to ChartPanel ViewBox scaleBy around centre on both axes and reset via _refresh_candles auto_range, with clamping and no-op when no bars.
acceptance_criteria: Given a loaded chart, When the plus button is clicked, Then the view zooms in around the chart centre on both axes, and when minus is clicked it zooms out around the centre.
Given Reset is clicked, When the action completes, Then the view returns to the default framing equivalent to a fresh chart load, including volume pane Y refit.
Given no bars are loaded or the view is at its range limits, When plus/minus or reset is invoked, Then the action is a safe no-op or is clamped and the application remains stable.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a loaded chart, When the plus button is clicked, Then the view zooms in around the chart centre on both axes, and when minus is clicked it zooms out around the centre.
tests.description: Record viewRange, emit zoom_in, assert xRange and yRange shrink symmetrically around centre; emit zoom_out and assert expansion.
tests.expected_result: xRange width *0.8 approx on zoom_in and *1.25 on zoom_out; centre unchanged within epsilon.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Reset is clicked, When the action completes, Then the view returns to the default framing equivalent to a fresh chart load, including volume pane Y refit.
tests.description: Zoom in twice, then emit reset and compare viewRange to that after update_chart auto_range.
tests.expected_result: Post-reset xRange and yRange equal fresh-load range within epsilon; volume Y refitted.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given no bars are loaded or the view is at its range limits, When plus/minus or reset is invoked, Then the action is a safe no-op or is clamped and the application remains stable.
tests.description: Call zoom slots with empty bars and with extreme zoom; assert no exception and range remains valid.
tests.expected_result: No exception, viewRange unchanged for empty bars, clamped finite range at limits.

tasks.title: Implement magnifier area-zoom with router precedence and cancel (D3)
tasks.description: Create ui/zoom_overlay.py rubber-band selection that sets both x and y range to the dragged rectangle, stays active after zoom, cancels on Esc/right-click, and has highest precedence in ChartMouseRouter.
acceptance_criteria: Given magnifier mode is active, When the user drags a rectangle and releases, Then the view sets both x and y range to that rectangle so it fills the chart.
Given magnifier mode is active and a drag is in progress, When Esc is pressed or a right-click occurs before release, Then the selection is cancelled and the view range is unchanged.
Given one magnifier zoom has completed, When the view has updated, Then magnifier mode remains active for a further selection.
Given a near-zero area drag or a drag starting outside the plot, When the gesture is released, Then the selection is ignored and no zoom occurs.

Given the symbol or timeframe changes while magnifier is active, When the new chart loads, Then magnifier mode resets to the default cursor. And given magnifier is active, magnifier has highest precedence in the mouse router.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given magnifier mode is active, When the user drags a rectangle and releases, Then the view sets both x and y range to that rectangle so it fills the chart.
tests.description: Enable magnifier, synthesize press-drag-release rectangle in scene coords, assert ViewBox range equals rectangle (both axes).
tests.expected_result: viewRange x and y equal dragged rect within epsilon; rubber band cleared.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given magnifier mode is active and a drag is in progress, When Esc is pressed or a right-click occurs before release, Then the selection is cancelled and the view range is unchanged.
tests.description: Start drag, send Esc key event and separately right-click; assert range unchanged and rubber band removed.
tests.expected_result: Range before equals range after; overlay selection cleared; mode still active.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given one magnifier zoom has completed, When the view has updated, Then magnifier mode remains active for a further selection.
tests.description: Complete one zoom, assert magnifier active flag true and button checked.
tests.expected_result: magnifier_active == True and ChartControls magnifier checked == True.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a near-zero area drag or a drag starting outside the plot, When the gesture is released, Then the selection is ignored and no zoom occurs.
tests.description: Drag 2px rectangle and drag starting outside view rect; assert no range change.
tests.expected_result: No zoom; range unchanged.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the symbol or timeframe changes while magnifier is active, When the new chart loads, Then magnifier mode resets to the default cursor. And given magnifier is active, magnifier has highest precedence in the mouse router.
tests.description: Enable magnifier, call set_timeframe/set_symbol; assert mode false/cursor Arrow; then test router returns True for magnifier before alarm/drawing when active.
tests.expected_result: Mode reset to false and cursor Arrow; router.view_mouse_press returns True for magnifier and does not reach alarm/drawing.
